samples.summary: `useDateFormat`/`subscribe` — the mechanism that makes the preference reactive — has no test at all
samples.evidence: tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts only exercises the plain functions `getDateFormat`/`setDateFormat`. The only "notification" test (lines 35-44) attaches its own raw `window.addEventListener("wafflebase-date-format-change", ...)` and counts dispatches; it never calls `subscribe()` or renders `useDateFormat`. If `subscribe` were a no-op, registered the wrong event, or failed to unsubscribe on cleanup, or if the `getServerSnapshot` argument were wrong, every test in the suite would still pass. The headline behavior of the change (Settings choice instantly updating the documents list, and cross-tab sync via the `storage` event) is therefore entirely uncovered — the `storage` listener at line 79 has no test whatsoever. Frontend already has React component/hook tests (e.g. tests/components/notifications/use-mark-read.test.tsx), so this is testable here.

samples.summary: New `readStoredTheme`/`writeStoredTheme` localStorage guards ship with no test
samples.evidence: The diff changes theme-provider behavior from "throws (blanking every route) when localStorage access throws" to "falls back to default / silently drops persistence". Grepping tests/ for `theme-provider`/`ThemeProvider` returns no files, and only tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts and tests/components/text-formatting/font-recents.test.ts mention localStorage at all. Nothing can fail if the try/catch guards are removed or if the fallback returns the wrong value (e.g. `null` vs `defaultTheme`), while the analogous guards in date-format-preference.ts did get read/write-throw tests.

samples.summary: `DateCell` wiring (tooltip title + format selection) is untested
samples.evidence: `formatFullDateTime` and `formatListDate` are unit-tested in isolation, but nothing renders `DateCell`. A swap of the two (tooltip showing the short date, or the cell showing the full timestamp), or dropping the `title` attribute entirely, would not fail any test. grep for `DateCell` returns only the definition and its single call site in src; no test file references it.

samples.summary: New Settings date-format Select has no test
samples.evidence: The new `<Select value={dateFormat} onValueChange={...setDateFormat...}>` section in settings/page.tsx is not covered by any test — no test file under packages/frontend/tests references the settings page. Nothing verifies the control reflects the stored preference or that choosing an option persists it, and the `value as DateDisplayFormat` cast means an unexpected value would silently pass through untested.

samples.summary: Assertion re-states a constant rather than testing behavior
samples.evidence: `expect(DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT).toBe("relative")` inside "defaults to relative when nothing is stored" only checks the exported constant equals its own literal; it adds nothing over the preceding `expect(getDateFormat()).toBe("relative")`. Harmless but vacuous.

finding.summary: `useDateFormat`/`subscribe` — the mechanism that makes the preference reactive — has no test at all
finding.evidence: tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts only exercises the plain functions `getDateFormat`/`setDateFormat`. The only "notification" test (lines 35-44) attaches its own raw `window.addEventListener("wafflebase-date-format-change", ...)` and counts dispatches; it never calls `subscribe()` or renders `useDateFormat`. If `subscribe` were a no-op, registered the wrong event, or failed to unsubscribe on cleanup, or if the `getServerSnapshot` argument were wrong, every test in the suite would still pass. The headline behavior of the change (Settings choice instantly updating the documents list, and cross-tab sync via the `storage` event) is therefore entirely uncovered — the `storage` listener at line 79 has no test whatsoever. Frontend already has React component/hook tests (e.g. tests/components/notifications/use-mark-read.test.tsx), so this is testable here.

verdict.reason: The reactive mechanism is genuinely untested. `subscribe` (date-format-preference.ts:77-84) is module-private and reachable only via `useDateFormat` (lines 90-94); the test file imports only DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT/getDateFormat/setDateFormat (test:3-7) and its sole notification test (test:35-44) attaches its own raw window listener and counts dispatches, never calling `subscribe` nor rendering the hook. No test anywhere dispatches a `storage` event or asserts listener cleanup. Repo-wide greps for useDateFormat, date-format-preference, wafflebase-date-format, DateCell and useSyncExternalStore (excluding node_modules) show the hook is referenced only by document-list.tsx:96,241 and settings/page.tsx:17-26 — and neither component is rendered by any test (their import paths appear only in source: workspace-documents.tsx:7, documents/page.tsx:6, App.tsx:19), so there is no indirect coverage path. This search also covers colocated src/**/*.test.tsx tests that a tests/** glob would miss. The existing document-list-utils tests (155-186) cover only the pure formatters, which take `format` as a parameter. renderHook is available in this package (use-mark-read.test.tsx:2,40), so the gap is not a tooling limitation. Under the test-adequacy rubric this is a clear behavior change (instant same-tab update plus cross-tab sync) with no meaningful test: major.

finding.summary: New `readStoredTheme`/`writeStoredTheme` localStorage guards ship with no test
finding.evidence: The diff changes theme-provider behavior from "throws (blanking every route) when localStorage access throws" to "falls back to default / silently drops persistence". Grepping tests/ for `theme-provider`/`ThemeProvider` returns no files, and only tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts and tests/components/text-formatting/font-recents.test.ts mention localStorage at all. Nothing can fail if the try/catch guards are removed or if the fallback returns the wrong value (e.g. `null` vs `defaultTheme`), while the analogous guards in date-format-preference.ts did get read/write-throw tests.

verdict.reason: Verified independently: `readStoredTheme`/`writeStoredTheme` exist at packages/frontend/src/components/theme-provider.tsx:25-40 and feed the initial state (line 65) and setTheme persistence (line 132). A repo-wide grep for `theme-provider|ThemeProvider|readStoredTheme|writeStoredTheme` matches only source consumers, eslint.config.js:27 (a react-refresh allow-list, not a test), and docs — no test file. Greps for `useTheme`/`components/theme` under any `tests/**` and for `theme` across all `*.test.tsx` return nothing; `**/*theme*` glob shows no theme-provider test beside the source; no e2e dir exists; no test imports App.tsx (which mounts ThemeProvider); no meta/lint test asserts localStorage guarding. I looked beyond the reviewer's paths, including colocated src tests and browser/visual harness specs. The throw-path is plainly testable in this repo's own idiom — board-grid.test.ts:201 ("survives storage that throws (private mode, blocked cookies)") and tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts do exactly that for analogous guards. Removing the try/catch, or returning something other than null so the `|| defaultTheme` fallback breaks, would fail no test. New behavior with zero meaningful coverage = major under the missing-tests branch.
